description: Server-side code for AdminCourseQueue page in an online examination system, handling session validation, database checks, and navigation actions.

classes.name: AdminQueue
classes.description: Code-behind class for AdminCourseQueue.aspx, manages admin operations related to course queue validation and navigation.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Handles page load event; checks session variables, verifies course queue data, performs database cleanup if necessary.

methods.name: homeB_Click
methods.description: Handles click event for home button; transfers user to AdminPanel.aspx.

methods.name: profileB_Click
methods.description: Handles click event for profile button; reloads current page as AdminQueue.aspx.

methods.name: LeaderboardB_Click
methods.description: Handles click event for leaderboard button; transfers user to AdminLeaderboard.aspx.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Handles click event for logout button; transfers user to LoginPage.aspx.

methods.name: GridView1_SelectedIndexChanged
methods.description: Handles selection change in GridView; stores selected student and course IDs in session, then navigates to ShowAns.aspx.
